_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Score has moved ±2+ in only 3% of recent windows and both brains describe a coiled market absorbing distribution with no confirmed breaker in either direction.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial split — both agree current phase is Denial and signal is HOLD, but analyst's forward phase is Disbelief while narrative stays in Denial.
next_move.confirmed_if: Fear & Greed holds 25-35 with BTC range-bounding $60-66K and funding staying positive but low
next_move.invalidated_if: ETF flows spike above 60 (escape to Hope) or VIX breaks 25 with BTC dumping below $58K (flush to Anxiety)
